name: DOI Publications
description: Provides a search and service for DOI publications.
project_description: DOI Publications looks up scholarly publication metadata by DOI (Digital Object Identifier) from the Crossref API. It provides a search page at /doi-search where a permitted user enters a DOI and sees the resolved title, authors, date, abstract, journal/container, links and cited references, plus a reusable service (doi_search.manager) whose getData($doi) method returns the Crossref record for use by other code (the companion doi_field module depends on it). It targets academic and library sites that reference works by DOI. There is no settings form; the only configuration is granting the 'access doi search' permission at /admin/people/permissions/module/doi_search.
